title: Floor 9 — Warm-Up & Reaction Boost
leyLine: After triggering Pyro or Dendro reactions, character Elemental Mastery increases by 200 for 8s.

chambers.firstHalf: Hilichurl Fighters, Pyro Hilichurl Grenadiers, Mitachurls
chambers.recSecond: Pyro + Cryo to break Fatui elemental shields
chambers.note: Group Treasure Hoarders quickly with Kazuha or Sucrose before they scatter.
Target Eremite summons when spawned to drop their enhanced RES.

chambers.secondHalf: Consecrated Red Vulture & Scorched Horned Crocodile
chambers.note: Swirling two different Abyss Mage shields breaks both simultaneously.

title: Floor 10 — Shield & Wave Check
leyLine: Characters gain +50% Normal and Charged Attack DMG while protected by a shield or healing effect.

chambers.note: Defeat both Kairagi together within 3 seconds so the survivor does not heal.
Apply Electro + Dendro when Primal Constructs turn invisible to stun them.
Fast Hydro application shreds the Abyss Lector Pyro shield cleanly.

title: Floor 11 — Monolith Defense & Lunar Surge (v7.2)
leyLine: All party members gain a +60% Electro DMG Bonus and +60% Cryo DMG Bonus.

chambers.firstHalf: Wave of Fatui Skirmishers & Pyro Shooters (Monolith Defense)
chambers.secondHalf: Automated Kuuvahki Drones & Spectral Enemies (Monolith Defense)
chambers.note: Pull ranged enemies away from the center Ley Line Monolith immediately.

chambers.secondHalf: Abyss Herald: Wicked Torrents & Frost Operatives
chambers.note: Bring shielded characters for Floor 11-2 Breacher Primuses and Dendro/Cryo for Hydro Herald shields.

chambers.recSecond: Bow carry (Chasca / Yelan / Fischl) to shoot wings
chambers.note: Enter Nightsoul Blessing in First Half to interrupt the Secret Source Automaton charge phase.

title: Floor 12 — Version 7.2 "Hour of Ruin" Endgame Check
leyLine: Normal Ley Line Flow (No chamber DMG buffs). Pure DPS, Nightsoul/Lunar shield breaking, and multi-wave check.

chambers.secondHalf: Tenebrous Papilla: Type II (Void Ward Shield)
chambers.recFirst: Mitya / Flins + Columbina Lunar-Charged or Neuvillette Furina
chambers.recSecond: Nightsoul / Fast Elemental Hitters (Mavuika, Kinich, Chasca, Ororon)
chambers.note: Void Ward fills rapidly from Nightsoul-aligned attacks or fast multi-hit Burning/Hyperbloom reactions.

chambers.recFirst: Columbina + Nefer / Lauma Lunar-Bloom or Mavuika Melt
chambers.note: Persistent Cryo application halts Overseer Device spin-up and strips its elevated elemental RES.

chambers.recFirst: Mitya + Valeriy + Alyosha or Mavuika + Citlali Melt
chambers.recSecond: Mavuika Melt / Arlecchino Vape / Lauma Hyperbloom
chambers.note: Avoid pure Hydro carries in 12-3 Second Half: Hydro Tulpa remains immune to Hydro DMG!
